description: Change the connection, multiblock state, placement position and/or direction behaviors of a block

minecraft:connection.description: Adds connection states to the block. The values of these states are updated when the block or neighboring blocks change.

minecraft:multi_block.description: Adds the "minecraft:multi_block_part" state and multi block functionality to the block.

minecraft:placement_direction.description: Adds the "minecraft:cardinal_direction", "minecraft:facing_direction", "minecraft:corner_and_cardinal_direction" and/or "minecraft:sixteen_way_rotation" states and setter function to the block.
minecraft:placement_direction.x-runtime-constraint-description: "y_rotation_offset" can only be used when "minecraft:cardinal_direction", "minecraft:facing_direction", and/or "minecraft:sixteen_way_rotation" are enabled in "enabled_states". and "blocks_to_corner_with" can only be used when "minecraft:corner_and_cardinal_direction" is enabled in "enabled_states".

minecraft:placement_position.description: Adds the "minecraft:block_face" and/or "minecraft:vertical_half" states and setter function to the block.
